Immunome, Inc. (NASDAQ: IMNM) today announced that Varegacestat PDUFA target action date set for April 28, 2027, following U.S. FDA acceptance of the New Drug Application (NDA).

The U.S. FDA accepted our NDA with a PDUFA target action date of April 28, 2027 under the standard review timeline.

Following its review, the U.S. FDA accepted Immunome's NDA and assigned a PDUFA target action date of April 28, 2027 for the therapy.
